text:
maria: I created a compact PR to centralize troubleshooting guidance for 429s, request timeouts, and server-side context trimming. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1527 :wave; goal is a single spot for engineers to point customers.
kevin: nice. please include a clear line about Dedicated burst buckets vs Hosted rate limits — they surface differently during sub-minute spikes.
sam: add Retry-After parsing examples (js + py) and call out fractional seconds and jitter. many implementations forget to add jitter.
tina: runtime note: sometimes infra retries to a compatible model variant which can return 200 with fewer tokens or a warning field. document the three visible outcomes so callers know what to expect.
maria: added mapping: rate-limit -> 429; runtime abort -> 504; context-trim -> 200 with "context_trimmed": true in body. added tiny JS/Python Retry-After snippets and a short flow on when to escalate retries (spike vs sustained).
docs-bot: checklist PR 1527: link-check, snippet-lint, SDK cross-ref. assigned to @kevin for review. :white_check_mark:
sam: small nit: under "when to back off" include one-sentence guidance: short spike -> brief retries + jitter; sustained -> exponential backoff + alert/support.
maria: added that. also linked the troubleshooting runbook for "intermittent 429s without console quota spike" which has carrier/backfill checks and infra signals.
support: thanks 152; we'll monitor tickets and flag any recurring confusion.
maria: planning to merge after kevin thumbs or small wording tweak. pinging @support and @eng-runtime for visibility. :rocket:
